- [ ] My branch starts from the latest `develop` and this pull request targets `develop`.
- [ ] The change is within the assigned issue scope.
- [ ] I ran relevant checks or explained why I could not.
- [ ] I added or updated tests when appropriate.
- [ ] I updated affected documentation when needed.
- [ ] I used English for repository-facing content, including comments and commit messages.
- [ ] I did not include secrets, credentials, or real personal data.
- [ ] I discussed significant dependency, architecture, security, or stack changes before implementing them.
